requires: new exact staging OAR2, operator/Registrar/NotChazz qualification and disposable test-role identities

runner_contract.transport: staging or mocked per separately admitted scope
runner_contract.credentials: test-role only; never service_role as participant proof
runner_contract.preimage: table-scoped digest of synthetic fixtures before case
runner_contract.postimage: same digest after case; exact expected changes only

cases.name: A own Current
cases.setup: A active owner session, one effective EnvPAC/Current
cases.expected: existing_c1, correct current_ref; no B fields

cases.name: B own Current
cases.setup: B independent fixture

cases.name: A tampers env/owner in body/query
cases.setup: A cookie, B request claim
cases.expected: server-derived A or request denied; never B

cases.name: cross-owner PAC review
cases.setup: A session, B pac_key, review_snapshot

cases.name: cross-owner Canopy reference
cases.setup: A session, B reference_key edit/remove/open

cases.name: foreign connection message/device
cases.setup: A session, connection with neither endpoint A
cases.expected: HLD/DNR; no ciphertext, device detail or new message

cases.name: revoked owner grant
cases.setup: A formerly valid session, grant revoked in disposable fixture

cases.name: expired or revoked session
cases.setup: A session expiry before clock / revoked_at set

cases.name: ambiguous grant/EnvPAC/Current
cases.setup: two qualifying fixture rows
cases.expected: 409 reconciliation_hold; no arbitrary first row authority

cases.name: scoped C2 session wrong target
cases.setup: A scoped session for X presented to Y

cases.name: scoped grant mismatch
cases.setup: same env but evidence_ref, role or initiative mismatch

cases.name: stale source after approval
cases.setup: owner approval hash differs from source snapshot

cases.name: owner authorizes exact projection
cases.setup: A owns exact current reviewed PAC and has qualified target
cases.expected: only qualified synthetic projection; receipt attributed A

cases.name: projection revoke and cached replay
cases.setup: grant revoked after initial permitted projection
cases.expected: no private replay, renewed authorization required

cases.name: ordinary role direct private data
cases.setup: anon/auth role, synthetic private PAC/session/grant fixtures
cases.expected: no rows or permission denied; service_role results excluded

cases.name: owner-rights view exposure regression

request.path: staging c3_envpac_effective_graph and seat review views

cases.setup: anon/auth, synthetic A/B only

cases.name: legacy privileged RPC bypass regression
cases.setup: ordinary role, synthetic queue only
cases.expected: permission denied or explicit authorized identity match required

cases.name: forged HMAC owner claim/replay
cases.setup: tampered signature/expired ticket/wrong env or reuse

cases.name: GET bookkeeping
cases.setup: A active session, no existing synthetic thread
cases.expected: record last_seen/thread writes; fail strict zero-write variant unless separately allowed

cases.name: model/provider/send denied
cases.setup: any fixture request for inference/send/publish/spend
